candidates.description: These tokens represent formatting, punctuation, and control characters commonly found in source code and mathematical markup languages like LaTeX.
This vector activates on closing punctuation marks, parentheses, and brackets often found at the end of code blocks or statements.
This vector represents part-of-speech tags, morphological suffixes, and syntactic markers commonly used in natural language processing.
This vector activates for mathematical symbols, operators, and notation.
This feature vector activates on LaTeX mathematical formatting commands and symbols.
This feature vector activates on mathematical terms related to numbers, algebra, and arithmetic operations.
These tokens represent evaluative adjectives, modalities, and capability concepts in Romance languages, primarily Italian and French.
This feature vector represents uppercase consonant and vowel letters of the English alphabet.
This feature vector represents words related to division, separation, differences, and distinction.
This vector represents prime numbers within the range from forty to one hundred.
